description: Copilot CLI writes one process log per session to ~/.copilot/logs/process-<timestamp>-<pid>.log under the default home. copilot-home-relocation covers COPILOT_HOME.
note: Path-only characterization: Telltale registers only project-local logs/copilot. The pinned upstream docs confirm the home path, not the fixture's contents. Static inspection of the official v1.0.96 Linux runtime archive (SHA256 e6c9513e7dcff38e424c247a8ae7b5b8a283e93973b77eb31fba9ef769f1c95b) finds logging help defining the named default level as info, but does not establish the adapter-required Accumulated output items format when invoked without logging flags. The log contents below are a Telltale synthetic fixture, not v1.0.96 output. Home discovery and supported promotion remain blocked on authoritative format/default-level evidence and successful discovery plus acquisition; a copied fixture alone cannot qualify upstream support. No live capture was performed.
